Restricted runtime roles and exact retained-image provenance
Production health, readiness and web/API proxy
Database outage refuses readiness and preserves existing processes on recovery
Graceful same-container/image API and Worker restart
Runtime-role secret rotation rejects previous credentials
Acceptance record identity, unavailable-Worker refusal and same-image recovery
consumerProof.scope: Source-free local rehearsal of a fully qualified integrated bundle. No production deployment, currentPR115 qualification, managed-provider acceptance, full user-journey completion or MVP completion inferred.

limits: Exact local source-free payload workflow and fresh disposable PostgreSQL namespace. Host has development tools installed but runtime commands use only the packaged payload and retained images; no source/runtime compilation occurs. Not a separate physically clean host, managed-provider certification, currentPR115 qualification or completeMVP acceptance.
